payload.core_mechanism_summary: Interval DP with extra dimension k: f(i,j,k) computes max points for s[i:j] given k preceding chars of same type as s[i], trying to merge equal characters across splits.
payload.rationale: The recursive function f(i,j,k) iterates over split point m where s[i]==s[m] to combine intervals, typical for interval DP on strings with character merging. Additional k dimension tracks accumulated count.
